name: fastapi_backend
description: Build a production-ready FastAPI backend with SQLite, Pydantic models, and JWT auth.
steps: Create project structure: app/, app/routers/, app/models/, app/schemas/, app/core/
Write requirements.txt with fastapi, uvicorn[standard], pydantic, sqlalchemy, python-jose[cryptography], passlib[bcrypt]
Write app/core/config.py with Settings using pydantic BaseSettings
Write app/core/database.py with SQLAlchemy engine and SessionLocal
Write app/core/security.py with password hashing and JWT token creation/verification
Write app/models/*.py with SQLAlchemy ORM models
Write app/schemas/*.py with Pydantic request/response schemas
Write app/routers/*.py with APIRouter for each resource
Write app/main.py with FastAPI app, CORS middleware, and router includes
Run: python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload to verify startup
best_practices: Use Pydantic v2 model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) for ORM mode
Separate concerns: routers handle HTTP, services handle business logic
Use Depends() for dependency injection (DB session, current user)
Return consistent response shapes: {data, message, status}
Use HTTPException with appropriate status codes
Hash passwords with bcrypt — never store plaintext
JWT tokens: access token (15min) + refresh token (7 days)
Add CORS middleware with explicit origins in production
Use alembic for migrations in production (include basic setup)
